text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I sent Dana her list in our DM, as a thread reply to her message. Moss's notes mention only two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492 comes from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk (Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
2. #4419 comes from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I also warned Dana that Marcus's own note "Q2 expansion wrap" (14 Jul 2025) describes #4419 as a Gate 3 printer delay instead. The same number has two descriptions, so she should check it with support before putting it in the weekly notes.

Moss's other two North notes have no Quarrendon ticket numbers. Moss's Central handoffs note lists #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon. There's no notes folder under Moss's name in the share.

I kept to Moss's notes, as she asked. The North weekly updates mention other Quarrendon tickets (#PD-8841, ND-2841, ND-2846, #4812, #4819, NORTH-241, SUP-4471). Dana can read those herself, but I didn't include them since they aren't from Moss.
